title: paper_v2 cash_ledger archive vs source schema divergence — handler must synthesize
description: Archive paper_v2_cash_ledger declares 7 cols (ledger_entry_id, entry_type, amount, balance_after, related_order_id, occurred_at, captured_at) that do not 1:1 map to source. Live paper_v2.cash_ledger source schema (probed): cash_id bigint, run_id, portfolio_id, fill_id, trade_date, symbol, side, notional, fee, cash_delta, cash_after, created_at. PaperV2ArchiveHandler T14b must synthesize archive fields: entry_type derived from (side, notional, fee, cash_delta); amount = abs(cash_delta) or notional+fee depending on entry_type; balance_after = cash_after; related_order_id = source.fill_id (or NULL when not order-related); occurred_at = trade_date or created_at decision required. This is deferred from round-2 P1.4 fix; flagged as design-pass follow-up, not blocker for T12 apply.
required_verification: design pass document covering all handler-derived field derivations (see BUG-011)
T14b implementation with explicit unit tests for each synthesized field
closure_requirements: Documented derivation rules for entry_type / amount / balance_after / occurred_at
T14b PaperV2ArchiveHandler tests covering edge cases (refund / fee-only / split-fill)

events.note: Round-2 P1.4 audit revealed source has no entry_type column at all - flagged as deferred design pass
